meta.name: verify-unattended
meta.description: Install, instrument and verify a web app end to end without pausing for a human. Use in an autonomous or goal-mode agent, in CI, or in any client that asks for approval on every command: it never says "restart your client" or "open a browser", because it takes a route that needs neither. Prefer the normal install-and-verify skill when a human is present and can answer.

copy.tagline_en: Install and verify a web app end to end without stopping for approval
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want an agent to install and verify a web app without pausing for approval

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自己完成安装、启动服务和验证 Web 应用的全过程,不需要你重启客户端或打开浏览器,最后给出 verified 为 yes、no 或 unknown 的结论。
howto.when: 在自主或目标模式 agent、CI,以及每条命令都要人工审批的客户端里接管;有人在场能回答时,更适合用普通的安装验证技能。

say.text: 帮我把这个 Web 应用装好并验证一遍,中间不用问我
say.note: 走 MCP 或 CLI 路线,最终给出一条结论

say.text: 把这次验证的反馈报给 Reticle,kind 填 gap
say.note: 调用 reticle_feedback 提交反馈后继续

howto.what_en: Claude installs, starts and verifies a web app end to end without waiting for a human, then reports a verdict of yes, no or unknown. It never asks you to restart the client or open a browser.
howto.when_en: Use in autonomous or goal-mode agents, in CI, or in clients that ask for approval on every command. Prefer the normal install-and-verify skill when a human is present and can answer.

say_en.text: Install and verify this web app, unattended, without asking me.
say_en.note: Uses the MCP tools or the CLI, and ends in a verdict.

say_en.text: Verify that POST /api/refund returns 200 with refunded:1187.01.
say_en.note: Declares the expected consequence before driving the app.

say_en.text: Report feedback to Reticle with kind gap.
